productsSection.title: Every section of the signal path.
productsSection.body: Six families, from flange to feed horn. Standard from stock or built to your drawing.

rigid.name: Rigid waveguide
rigid.short: Straight sections, E-plane and H-plane bends, twists.
rigid.description: Rigid rectangular waveguide for microwave links, radar, satellite and test benches. Straight sections, E-plane and H-plane bends, twists and assemblies to specification, with flanges fitted and checked.

flexible.name: Flexible & twistable waveguide
flexible.short: Made in-house. Absorbs vibration and misalignment.
flexible.description: Flexible and flexible-twistable waveguide built entirely by Tecnolambro. Connects radio and antenna when flanges are not aligned, absorbs vibration and thermal expansion, and makes installation easier.
applications: Correcting offsets and rotation between flanges

feeds.name: Antenna feed horns
feeds.short: Where the signal leaves the waveguide and meets the dish.
feeds.description: Feeds and horns for parabolic antennas. They transfer energy from the waveguide to the reflector, and collect it on receive, with a pattern matched to the antenna optics.

transitions.name: Waveguide transitions
transitions.short: From one size to another, from waveguide to coax.
transitions.description: Transitions between waveguide sizes, between flange types and from waveguide to coaxial connector. The profile is designed to keep VSWR low across the common band.

flanges.name: Flanges & installation kits
flanges.short: Flanges, covers, gaskets and hardware for microwave links.
flanges.description: Everything needed to install and seal a waveguide run: flanges, covers, gaskets and hardware. Available individually or in kits by size.
applications: Installation and maintenance of microwave links

custom.name: Build-to-print
custom.short: Special parts and nickel electroforms to your specification.
custom.description: When the part is not in the catalogue, we build it. Our in-house engineering office starts from your drawing or specification, the workshop makes the part and the lab tests it. We also produce nickel electroforms.

faqSection.title: Frequently asked questions
faqSection.body: Answers to the questions engineering and purchasing teams ask us most.

sizes.q: Which waveguide sizes do you make?
sizes.a: We work across the standard rectangular sizes from WR-229 (3.3-4.9 GHz) to WR-28 (26.5-40 GHz). To match an exact frequency, use the band finder on the home page or state the frequency in your quote request.

custom.q: Do you build parts to customer drawings?
custom.a: Yes. Our in-house engineering office starts from your drawing or specification, checks feasibility and prepares the detailed design. We make single parts, small batches and nickel electroforms.

files.q: Which file formats can I send?
files.a: PDF, DWG, DXF or STEP, up to 20 MB per file, straight from the quote form. A dimensioned PDF with tolerances and finish is enough for a first offer; a STEP model helps with complex geometry.

leadTime.a: Standard parts from the shop ship within 48 hours. For build-to-print parts the lead time depends on geometry, treatments and quantity, and we state it in the quote. [TO BE COMPLETED: typical lead times by family]

moq.q: Is there a minimum order quantity?
moq.a: [TO BE COMPLETED: minimum order quantities, if any] In the shop, unit price drops with quantity.

shippingEu.q: Do you ship across the European Union?
shippingEu.a: Yes, we ship from our stock in Miradolo Terme, Italy. [TO BE COMPLETED: carriers, indicative EU lead times and costs]

shippingWorld.q: Do you ship outside the European Union?
shippingWorld.a: Yes, we work with customers worldwide. Exports are zero-rated for Italian VAT. [TO BE COMPLETED: countries served, Incoterms, customs documents]

invoicing.q: How do you invoice an EU company with a VAT number?
invoicing.a: With a valid EU VAT number (checked in VIES) we invoice without Italian VAT: the customer accounts for the tax under the reverse-charge mechanism. Enter your VAT number in the quote form.

materials.q: Which materials and finishes do you use?
materials.a: Bright dipping and painting are done in our own plant; heat treatment and plating with selected partners. [TO BE COMPLETED: available materials and finishes]

testing.a: Yes. Our in-house lab performs electrical and dimensional inspection before shipping. [TO BE COMPLETED: parameters measured and documents supplied with the part]

flexTwist.q: What is the difference between flexible and flexible-twistable waveguide?
flexTwist.a: Flexible waveguide bends in the E and H planes to connect flanges that are not aligned. Flexible-twistable waveguide also allows torsion around its own axis, useful when the two flanges are rotated relative to each other. We make both.

shopVsQuote.q: When should I use the shop and when should I ask for a quote?
shopVsQuote.a: The shop is for standard parts in the most common sizes, with immediate price and dispatch. For other sizes, flanges or lengths, large quantities or build-to-print parts, request a quote.

For any privacy request: info@tecnolambro.it, phone +39 0382 75385.
Data entered in the quote request form: full name, company, email, phone (optional), country, VAT number (optional), description of the request, sizes and quantities.
Files uploaded with the request (drawings in PDF, DWG, DXF or STEP). Drawings may contain personal data, for example the designer’s name in the title block.
Browsing data: IP address and technical information logged by the server for security and operation. Aggregate, anonymous visit statistics without cookies (see section 7).
To answer the quote request and handle pre-contractual negotiations: legal basis Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (steps taken at the request of the data subject).
To comply with legal obligations, for example tax and accounting, if the request becomes an order: Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR.
To keep the website secure and measure its use in aggregate form: legitimate interest of the controller, Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.
We do not use data for marketing without separate consent and we do not sell it to third parties.
Quote requests and attached files: for as long as needed to handle the request and up to 24 months after the last contact, unless they become an order.
Documents relating to orders and invoices: 10 years, as required by tax law.
Server technical logs: up to 12 months.
[TO BE COMPLETED: confirm retention periods with the owner]

To exercise them, write to info@tecnolambro.it. We reply within 30 days.
You have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority, Garante per la protezione dei dati personali (www.garanteprivacy.it), or with the authority of your EU country.
If enabled, we use Plausible Analytics, a cookie-free analytics service that collects no personal data and does not track users across sites. Data is aggregate and anonymous.
The website uses only technical browser storage (chosen theme, intro animation already seen). Details in the cookie policy.

Drawings, models and specifications you send remain your property, with all intellectual property rights.

We use them only to assess feasibility and prepare the quote and, if you order, to build the part. We do not share them with third parties, except with partners carrying out a manufacturing step on your behalf, bound by confidentiality.
On request we delete files not linked to an order. If you need a non-disclosure agreement (NDA), we sign it before you send the drawings.
Texts, technical drawings, graphics and the Tecnolambro brand are protected. They may not be copied or reused without written permission, except quoting with a link.
We take care that the content is accurate but cannot guarantee it is always complete or up to date. Before a purchase, the offer and order confirmation prevail.
The website may link to external sites, including the online shop, which have their own terms.
